mostCommon.name: Monosodium Glutamate (MSG)
mostCommon.foundInProducts: 23 out of every 100 products in Norwegian stores

topTenToAvoid.name: Sodium nitrite
topTenToAvoid.why: Linked to colorectal cancer in processed meats

topTenToAvoid.name: Sulphite ammonia caramel
topTenToAvoid.why: Used mainly in cola drinks, controversial additive

topTenToAvoid.name: Silicon dioxide
topTenToAvoid.why: Some concerns about nanoparticles; moderate safety rating

topTenCommon.name: Mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids

keyInsights.title: MSG is everywhere
keyInsights.description: 23% of Norwegian products contain E621 (MSG). It's in everything from instant noodles to gravy mixes.

keyInsights.title: Processed meats are the risk
keyInsights.description: E250 & E251 (nitrites/nitrates) are found mainly in ham, bacon, salami. Avoid these if possible.

keyInsights.title: Most additives are safe
keyInsights.description: 71% of common additives in Norwegian stores are safety-rated as 'safe' (E300, E330, E407, etc.)

keyInsights.title: Thickeners dominate
keyInsights.description: E407, E412, E415 (all safe) are in ~15-17% of products. They're used in yogurt, desserts, sauces.

keyInsights.title: Cola's triple threat
keyInsights.description: Dark sodas contain E150d (caramel), E338 (phosphoric acid), and often E621. Avoid or minimize.
